faqs.question: What does the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Other test measure?
faqs.answer: This test detects Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB Complex) or Non-tuberculosis bacteria (NTM or MOTT) in a patient's specimen.

faqs.question: Why is the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Other test done?
faqs.answer: • To diagnose infections caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis or Non-tuberculosis bacteria • To rule out tuberculosis in patients suspected of having the disease • To monitor treatment efficacy for tuberculosis or other bacterial infections • To identify the specific bacteria causing an infection for targeted treatment

faqs.question: When is the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Other test recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: This test is usually recommended when • A patient exhibits symptoms of tuberculosis, such as persistent cough, weight loss, and night sweats. • Tuberculosis exposure is suspected. • Previous tests suggest the presence of mycobacterial infection. • Clinicians need to identify the specific bacteria causing an infection.

faqs.question: What if the results of the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Other test are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results may indicate an active tuberculosis infection or another bacterial infection.

faqs.question: What to expect during the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Other test?
faqs.answer: To conduct this test, you need to provide a 2ml specimen in a sterile leak-proof container. The sample will be sent to the laboratory for processing.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Other test?
faqs.answer: Before the test: • Ensure proper specimen collection with clinical history mentioned on the Test Request Form. • Follow any instructions from your doctor regarding fasting, medication restrictions, or specific dietary requirements. • Bring any relevant reports or information provided by your clinician. Please reach out to your healthcare provider for any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Other test?
faqs.answer: Additional tests that may be ordered alongside the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Other test include: • Acid-Fast Bacilli (AFB) smear microscopy: This test detects the presence of acid-fast bacilli in a patient's specimen. • Nucleic acid amplification tests: These tests identify specific genetic material from Mycobacterium tuberculosis to aid in diagnosis. • Drug susceptibility testing: This test determines which antibiotics will effectively treat the identified bacteria.

faqs.question: What is the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Other test also known as?
faqs.answer: AFB culture, Mycobacterial Growth Indicator Tube (MGIT) culture

faqs.question: What is tuberculosis?
faqs.answer: Tuberculosis (TB) is a contagious bacterial infection caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis. It primarily affects the lungs but can also impact other parts of the body. TB spreads through airborne droplets when an infected person coughs or sneezes.
